channel.description: Staff channel of the log. Keep it private: it names members and links to their messages.

channels.description: Send a category to its own channel instead (members: joins, leaves, roles, nicknames; messages: edits and deletions; plugins: moderation cases and polls).

joins.description: A member joins (with the account age).

leaves.description: A member leaves, is kicked or banned.

roles.description: Roles added to or removed from a member.

messageEdits.description: A message is edited. Discord also reports link previews as edits, so this is noisy.

messageDeletes.description: A message is deleted (author when known).

moderation.description: Cases published by the moderation plugin (moderation.case).

ignoredChannels.description: Message edits and deletions in these channels are not logged.

ignoreBots.description: Ignore bots (their joins, role changes and messages).

batchSeconds.description: Events are collected for this long and posted together. 0 posts every event right away (no rate limit).

maxPerBatch.description: Most events posted per batch. The rest are counted, not posted, so a raid cannot flood the log.
